name: Native USB Names
author: NachoCasta
summary: Show USB volume labels when no rekordbox device name is set.
description: The XDJ-AZ can show a generic USB1 or USB2 name when a USB drive has no device name configured in rekordbox. Native USB Names uses the drive's filesystem volume label instead, making unnamed drives easier to identify. A valid rekordbox device name always takes priority and keeps its original case. If neither name is usable, the native USB1/USB2 fallback remains. Changes display names only: no disk renaming or library changes. Native icons, colors and USB identities are preserved; USB Hub Support is not required.
